# DeepL-oFM 1.0.10
The window comes back, and the iPhone app is here.
- **Window reopen fix**: closing the window keeps DeepL-oFM in the menu bar; the clipboard hotkey (⌥⌘T) and the menu bar item bring it back instead of leaving the app active without a window. - **iPhone app source**: `ios/` now contains a SwiftUI app with the same translation core, nine interface languages, cloud providers and a custom LAN endpoint. Build it with XcodeGen and Xcode; instructions are in `ios/README.md`. - All nine README editions include localized screenshots and the demo GIF.

# DeepL-oFM 1.0.9
Menu-bar-only mode and documentation in nine languages.
- **Dock icon switch**: hide DeepL-oFM from the Dock and keep it in the menu bar. If the menu bar icon is off, turning off the Dock icon enables it automatically. - **Nine README editions** with localized screenshots and the demo GIF: English, Ukrainian, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese and Italian. - Each edition links to all the others, and the website links the full documentation in every language.

# DeepL-oFM 1.0.8
Nine interface languages, a Markdown view, and file translation that keeps the original document.
- Interface in English, Ukrainian, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese and Italian. - Three result views: rendered Markdown, plain text without markup, and the raw Markdown source. Copy follows the active view. - Rich paste: HTML/RTF from a browser or a word processor becomes Markdown, so headings, lists, links and emphasis survive translation. - File translation for `.txt`, `.md`, `.pdf` and `.docx`, from the File menu or by dropping a file onto the window. - DOCX is updated in place — only `word/document.xml` changes — so styles, images, tables, headers and fonts stay untouched. - PDF keeps the original pages, layout, images and typography; the translation is drawn into the same text blocks. - Refined style and tone selectors, Settings in the ⋯ menu (Escape returns to translation), and a fix for model ids at the end of a sentence.
Signed and notarized DMG; the previous 1.0.7 installs this update through Sparkle.

# DeepL-oFM 1.0.7
Fallback provider, automatic preload, better Groq support and wider text.
- **Fallback provider/model**: if the primary provider fails, the same text is retried automatically with the fallback you choose. The status bar shows a “fallback” chip. - **Load the translator at launch**: connects to the provider, refreshes the model list and warms up a local model. Can be disabled in Behavior. - **Groq fix**: Unicode hyphens in model IDs (`Hy‑MT2`) no longer make the app discard a valid translation and fall back to the untranslated source. - **History tab** disappears when “Keep translation history” is off. - **Typography**: wider text panes and larger line spacing. - Signed and notarized DMG with an Applications shortcut; Sparkle update feed.
If you are on 1.0.6, this is the first update delivered through Sparkle.
